methods.label: Use the sign inside the absolute value
methods.explanation:
The condition \(x<2\) tells us that \(x-2<0\). The absolute value of a negative number is its opposite, so
\[
p=|x-2|=-(x-2)=2-x>0.
\]
Rearranging gives \(x=2-p\). Substituting this into the requested expression yields
\[
x-p=(2-p)-p=\boxed{2-2p}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
